prompt: Set up DataForSEO for my gateway so OpenSEO works.

rules.name: no-account-yet
rules.reply: No, I don't have a DataForSEO account yet, and I've never run OpenSEO anywhere else.

rules.name: registered
rules.reply: I'm in. I registered, confirmed the email, and the dashboard at app.dataforseo.com shows a $1 balance.

rules.name: api-access-open
rules.reply: I can see them. The API Access page shows the API login, the API password and a Base64 string, and the IP Access list is empty. I've left the page open.
Done. I ran it in a second terminal in the every-app folder and pasted my API login, a colon and the API password at the hidden prompt. It said DATAFORSEO_API_KEY is set on the Gateway.

rules.name: curl-check
rules.reply: I exported the variable with a leading space and ran the curl line in my terminal. It printed status 20000, message Ok., balance 1. Then I ran unset DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.

rules.name: app-check
rules.reply: I opened OpenSEO, opened a project, went to Keyword Research and searched one keyword. Search volume and difficulty appeared.

rules.name: funds-skipped
rules.reply: I'll skip adding funds for now; the $1 trial credit is enough to test. I set a daily limit under API Settings.
